checks: Default Supabase implicit recovery fragment opens new-password and confirmation fields
Recovery credentials scrubbed from URL; opening the link makes no password-mutation request
Access and refresh credentials are absent from browser persistent storage
Mismatched passwords are rejected without an API mutation
Explicit reset sends only original access bearer plus matching passwords and returns to sign-in success state
Custom token_hash recovery also opens the password form without consuming it on page load
Server-rejected expired/reused links show a clear error, clear passwords and stop repeated submission
Request-new-link action returns to email request intentionally, without a redirect loop
Provider expiry errors render a request-new-email explanation and scrub URL material
A non-recovery fragment does not expose password-update fields
Temporary recovery API outage remains retryable without falling back to the email form
scope: Actual built React UI in Chromium with synthetic API interception and synthetic recovery credentials; no real account, email or password was used.
